guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 圍堰水壓、圍檁支撐與基底滲流穩定。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Cofferdam water pressure, walers, struts and base seepage. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 合成教學假設：外側水深H=6 m、內側乾燥、γw=9.81 kN/m³，每米牆合力P=γwH²/2=176.6 kN/m

合成教學假設：假設鉸接有效長L=8 m、E=200 GPa、I=0.0002 m⁴，Pcr=π²EI/L²=6.17 MN
合成教學假設：假設20處鎖口各漏q=0.3 L/min，總Q=20q=6 L/min
合成教學假設：假設土粒比重Gs=2.65、孔隙比e=0.65，理想臨界坡降icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.0

factsEn: Synthetic teaching assumptions: For external depth H=6 m, a dry inside and γw=9.81 kN/m³, force per wall metre P=γwH²/2=176.6 kN/m
Synthetic teaching assumptions: For a simply supported waler with w=80 kN/m and span L=3 m, M=wL²/8=90 kN·m
Synthetic teaching assumptions: For pinned effective length L=8 m, E=200 GPa and I=0.0002 m⁴, Pcr=π²EI/L²=6.17 MN
Synthetic teaching assumptions: For twenty interlocks each leaking q=0.3 L/min, total flow Q=20q=6 L/min
Synthetic teaching assumptions: For grain specific gravity Gs=2.65 and void ratio e=0.65, ideal critical gradient icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.0
Synthetic teaching assumptions: For effective unit weight γ′=10 kN/m³, Kp=3 and embedment d=3 m, ideal Pp=0.5Kpγ′d²=135 kN/m

沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。

procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, ground and groundwater, support system and construction method.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：鋼板樁圍堰支撐
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Sheet-pile cofferdam bracing
guides.concept: 鋼板樁圍堰的安全取決於水土壓、支撐系統、鎖口止水與開挖底部的滲流穩定。本課以逐階段自由體圖連結抽水、支撐預力、樁趾被動反力及拆撐，並檢查角隅扭矩、水流拖曳與材料劣化，避免只用單根板樁彎矩代表整個圍堰。
guides.conceptEn: Sheet-pile cofferdams depend on water and earth pressures, bracing, interlock sealing and base seepage stability. Stage-specific free bodies connect dewatering, support force, toe resistance and removal, with checks of corner torsion, current drag and deterioration beyond the bending demand of one sheet pile.
procedure: 圍堰抽水降低內側水位，外側靜水壓沿深度增加，合力及作用點共同決定板樁與支撐需求。水位差變化會同時改變側壓及底部滲流，不能把抽水只當作施工準備；分層水位或波動需按相應邊界逐階段更新。三角形公式假設單側靜水且內側乾燥；兩側都有水時應相減完整壓力圖，不能無條件只代水位差平方。
圍檁收集多片板樁的側向反力並傳給離散支撐，跨距、連續性及支撐座位置因此決定局部彎矩。荷載不一定均布，板樁接觸不良會使部分圍檁先受力；施工偏心也可能讓名義平面彎曲變成扭轉與局部腹板承壓。簡支均布式只提供比較量級，連續梁、接頭滑移與角隅都會改變彎矩分布；構件強度與側向穩定須另查。
受壓支撐會受整體挫屈控制，長度與端部拘束的影響可能比截面面積更大。安裝彎曲、接頭偏心與側向支承失效會降低承載，不能把理想歐拉荷重當可直接使用的設計抗力；施工期間堆料也可能增加橫向彎曲。歐拉式假設彈性、理想直桿與指定端部條件；設計抗力還須納入缺陷、局部挫屈與規範折減，不是本算值本身。
板樁鎖口提供相互連接卻不一定天然水密，施工損傷與不連續封材可形成縱向漏水路徑。多處小漏點相加後會影響排水容量，若伴隨細砂則也涉及地層流失；鎖口幾何及實際嵌合需要與水頭一起判讀。線性加總假設各漏點保持原流量，實際堵塞或壓力重分配會改變總量；流量合格仍不能證明無帶砂風險。
向上滲流會減少土粒有效重量，當滲透力接近浮重時，顆粒接觸力大幅降低並可能形成砂湧。基底管湧不一定與板樁彎曲超載同時發生，因此結構支撐足夠仍需獨立查滲流路徑、出口坡降及反濾保護。這是均質無黏性土的理想起浮條件，非專案安全係數；內部侵蝕可在其他條件下發生，分層與集中水路須另外分析。
板樁嵌入開挖底以下，藉由前方土體被動作用提供平衡，但動員此抗力需要適當位移。開挖擾動、沖刷或砂湧會減少可用深度，若把全被動強度無條件計入，將高估支承並低估板樁轉動及支撐力。公式假設均質土、水平地面及理想被動狀態，未含折減與變形要求；實際設計需考慮水壓和土壓分開的有效應力分析。
內部水位下降時，原先平衡外水壓的一部分內壓被移除，支撐需求因而增加。分析必須以固定板樁高程比較前後兩張壓力圖，不能只看水深數字；若抽水與開挖同時進行，土壓重分配也需另列。此差值僅比較指定兩個三角形合力，作用點也會改變；若分析兩側水位差，需保留共同底高與完整壓力分布。
圍堰角隅把兩個方向的圍檁反力轉接到支撐，幾何偏心容易產生額外扭矩。直線段的平面梁分析不能自動涵蓋角接件、焊接與腹板局部承壓，若支撐軸線未交會，荷載路徑需要明確的三維構件傳遞。力乘偏心只是附加扭矩，不包含兩方向力的合成與接頭剛度；連接強度及圍檁扭轉穩定仍需另外驗算。
圍堰暴露於水流時，流速、投影面積與形狀決定拖曳作用，與靜水壓屬不同荷載來源。漂流物或局部流束會改變有效面積及阻力，洪水期間的水位與流速也可能同時增加，不能只沿用施工初期的靜水情境。阻力係數依形狀及流況而變，此式不含波浪、撞擊或渦激效應；不能把假設係數直接當通用設計值。
拆除一層支撐會改變板樁及圍檁的有效跨距，原有內力隨新的邊界重新分配。永久結構必須先形成可證明的替代支承，材料強度達標並不保證連接已完成；拆撐順序常比最終狀態更容易產生不利彎曲與位移。平方比只適用於假設的簡支均布系統，實際連續壁及土彈簧會改變分配；應依真實拆撐階段重新分析，而非套用倍率設計。
procedureEn: Dewatering lowers the inside level while external hydrostatic pressure rises with depth; both resultant and application point govern sheets and braces. Water-level changes also alter base seepage, so pumping is a structural stage rather than mere preparation. Layered heads and fluctuations require stage-specific boundary updates. The triangular expression assumes one-sided static water and a dry interior; with water on both sides subtract complete pressure diagrams rather than automatically squaring the level difference.

Walers collect reactions from multiple sheets and transfer them to discrete braces, making span, continuity and seating position critical to local bending. Loads need not be uniform: poor contact concentrates reactions, while construction eccentricity can add torsion and local web bearing to nominal in-plane bending. The simple uniform-load expression is a scale comparison; continuity, splice slip and corners alter moment distribution, and member resistance and lateral stability require separate checks.

Compression struts may be governed by global buckling, with length and end restraint more influential than area alone. Initial bow, splice eccentricity and lost lateral restraint reduce resistance. Ideal Euler load is not directly usable design resistance, and construction stockpiles may add transverse bending to the member. Euler theory assumes an elastic straight ideal member with specified ends; design resistance also includes imperfections, local buckling and code reductions rather than using this number directly.

Interlocks connect sheets but are not inherently watertight; driving damage and discontinuous sealant create longitudinal leakage paths. Many small leaks can consume pumping capacity, while entrained fines indicate ground loss. Interlock geometry and actual engagement must therefore be interpreted together with hydraulic head. Linear summation assumes unchanged individual leakage; blockage and pressure redistribution alter totals, and acceptable flow does not establish absence of soil-transport risk.

Upward seepage reduces effective grain weight; as seepage force approaches submerged weight, contact forces fall and boiling may develop. Hydraulic instability need not coincide with excessive sheet bending. Adequate structural bracing therefore still requires independent assessment of seepage paths, exit gradients and filter protection. This is an ideal heave condition for homogeneous cohesionless soil, not a project safety factor; internal erosion can occur under other conditions, requiring analysis of layering and concentrated paths.

Embedded sheets mobilize passive soil resistance below excavation, but that resistance requires displacement. Disturbance, scour or boiling reduces usable embedment. Crediting full passive strength unconditionally overstates restraint and underestimates sheet rotation and brace force, particularly when soil and structural deformation compatibility has not been checked. The expression assumes uniform soil, level ground and an ideal passive state without reductions or movement requirements; actual design separates water and effective earth pressures.

Lowering internal water removes part of the pressure that previously balanced the external side, increasing brace demand. Compare complete pressure diagrams at fixed sheet elevations rather than depth numbers alone. When pumping and excavation occur together, earth-pressure redistribution must be accounted for separately from the hydraulic change. The difference compares the specified triangular resultants only, whose application points also change; two-sided water-level analysis needs a common base and complete pressure distributions.

Cofferdam corners transfer waler reactions from two directions into bracing, with geometric eccentricity producing extra torsion. A straight-wall planar beam analysis does not automatically cover corner fittings, welds or local web bearing. Nonintersecting strut axes require an explicit three-dimensional structural path for the forces. Force times eccentricity is only the added torque; combined two-direction loading and connection stiffness require further analysis, including connection resistance and waler torsional stability.

Current drag is distinct from hydrostatic pressure and depends on velocity, projected area and shape. Debris and local jets can change effective area and resistance, while flood levels and velocities may rise together. The initial construction hydrostatic case therefore does not necessarily represent later environmental demand. The drag coefficient depends on shape and flow regime; this expression excludes waves, impact and vortex effects, and the assumed coefficient is not universal.

Removing a brace changes effective sheet and waler spans and redistributes forces under new boundaries. Permanent works must first provide demonstrable replacement restraint; adequate material strength does not prove completed connections. The removal sequence may produce more adverse bending and movement than the final state. The squared ratio applies only to the assumed simple uniform-load system; wall continuity and soil springs change redistribution, requiring analysis of actual removal stages rather than design by this multiplier.
evidence: 每次改變水位應對照核定支撐階段；抽水放行由臨時工程與地工設計者共同確認。三角形公式假設單側靜水且內側乾燥；兩側都有水時應相減完整壓力圖，不能無條件只代水位差平方。
接觸墊塊、接頭與腹板加勁須依圖驗收；任何支撐間距變更由臨時工程設計者核准。簡支均布式只提供比較量級，連續梁、接頭滑移與角隅都會改變彎矩分布；構件強度與側向穩定須另查。
支撐不得被當未核准的吊掛梁使用；移除側向約束前須由臨時工程設計者重新核算有效長度。歐拉式假設彈性、理想直桿與指定端部條件；設計抗力還須納入缺陷、局部挫屈與規範折減，不是本算值本身。
鎖口修補需同時查外水頭及地層流失，補漏停留點由圍堰設計者確認，不以泵浦尚能排除作唯一判據。線性加總假設各漏點保持原流量，實際堵塞或壓力重分配會改變總量；流量合格仍不能證明無帶砂風險。
抽水計畫需設水壓及帶砂觀測停留點；地工設計者確認出口坡降與反濾條件後才改變內水位。這是均質無黏性土的理想起浮條件，非專案安全係數；內部侵蝕可在其他條件下發生，分層與集中水路須另外分析。
evidenceEn: Check every level change against the approved brace stage; temporary-works and geotechnical designers jointly release dewatering. The triangular expression assumes one-sided static water and a dry interior; with water on both sides subtract complete pressure diagrams rather than automatically squaring the level difference.

Inspect contact packs, splices and web stiffeners against drawings; the temporary-works designer approves every change in brace spacing. The simple uniform-load expression is a scale comparison; continuity, splice slip and corners alter moment distribution, and member resistance and lateral stability require separate checks.

Do not use struts as unapproved lifting beams; the temporary-works designer recalculates effective length before lateral restraint is removed. Euler theory assumes an elastic straight ideal member with specified ends; design resistance also includes imperfections, local buckling and code reductions rather than using this number directly.

Leak repair must consider external head and soil loss; the cofferdam designer confirms repair hold points rather than relying only on available pumping capacity. Linear summation assumes unchanged individual leakage; blockage and pressure redistribution alter totals, and acceptable flow does not establish absence of soil-transport risk.

Dewatering plans include pressure and sediment hold points; the geotechnical designer confirms exit gradients and filtration before internal levels change. This is an ideal heave condition for homogeneous cohesionless soil, not a project safety factor; internal erosion can occur under other conditions, requiring analysis of layering and concentrated paths.
pitfalls: 抽水後若支撐未形成完整力流，板樁可能快速變形，水壓與土壓需求一起超過臨時狀態能力。三角形公式假設單側靜水且內側乾燥；兩側都有水時應相減完整壓力圖，不能無條件只代水位差平方。
側向繫材被拆或支撐初彎過大，可能在材料尚未達降伏時失穩並使鄰跨連鎖超載。歐拉式假設彈性、理想直桿與指定端部條件；設計抗力還須納入缺陷、局部挫屈與規範折減，不是本算值本身。
基底砂湧會流失土粒並削弱樁趾反力，繼而影響整體圍堰；表面出水量不大也不能忽略。這是均質無黏性土的理想起浮條件，非專案安全係數；內部侵蝕可在其他條件下發生，分層與集中水路須另外分析。
同時降低水位與移除支撐會疊加不利作用，可能讓尚未形成永久支承的板樁失去平衡。此差值僅比較指定兩個三角形合力，作用點也會改變；若分析兩側水位差，需保留共同底高與完整壓力分布。
漂流物增加迎水面積可提高拖曳並導致沖刷，趾部抗力下降又使圍堰側移增加。阻力係數依形狀及流況而變，此式不含波浪、撞擊或渦激效應；不能把假設係數直接當通用設計值。
pitfallsEn: Dewatering before the full brace load path exists can cause rapid sheet movement as combined water and soil demands exceed temporary-stage resistance. The triangular expression assumes one-sided static water and a dry interior; with water on both sides subtract complete pressure diagrams rather than automatically squaring the level difference.

Removed lateral ties or excessive initial bow can trigger instability before material yielding and redistribute overload into adjacent bays. Euler theory assumes an elastic straight ideal member with specified ends; design resistance also includes imperfections, local buckling and code reductions rather than using this number directly.

Base boiling removes soil and weakens toe restraint, subsequently affecting the whole cofferdam; even modest visible flow can be significant. This is an ideal heave condition for homogeneous cohesionless soil, not a project safety factor; internal erosion can occur under other conditions, requiring analysis of layering and concentrated paths.

Lowering water while removing braces combines adverse actions and may destabilize sheets before permanent restraint is available. The difference compares the specified triangular resultants only, whose application points also change; two-sided water-level analysis needs a common base and complete pressure distributions.

Debris increases exposed area and can intensify drag and scour, while reduced toe resistance further increases cofferdam movement. The drag coefficient depends on shape and flow regime; this expression excludes waves, impact and vortex effects, and the assumed coefficient is not universal.

history.title: 鋼板樁圍堰支撐
history.text: 鋼板樁圍堰的安全取決於水土壓、支撐系統、鎖口止水與開挖底部的滲流穩定。本課以逐階段自由體圖連結抽水、支撐預力、樁趾被動反力及拆撐，並檢查角隅扭矩、水流拖曳與材料劣化，避免只用單根板樁彎矩代表整個圍堰。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。1994年：美國陸軍工兵署發布鋼板樁牆設計手冊，涵蓋土體結構互制；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2020年：香港擋土牆設計指南提供二〇二〇年版本，其適用範圍不全面涵蓋深開挖。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Sheet-pile cofferdams depend on water and earth pressures, bracing, interlock sealing and base seepage stability. Stage-specific free bodies connect dewatering, support force, toe resistance and removal, with checks of corner torsion, current drag and deterioration beyond the bending demand of one sheet pile. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 1994: USACE publishes its sheet-pile wall manual including soil-structure interaction; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2020: CEDD provides the 2020 retaining-wall guide, whose scope does not comprehensively cover deep excavation. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.
